messages:
maria: Anyone seeing child spans drop for cross-region requests? Root spans present, but many children missing around 02:15-02:20 UTC.
alex: yep, noticed spikes at 2026-03-05T02:17Z, traces for /api/v1/route show only root + DB exit, no downstream service spans :confused:
ben: exporter logs show multiple 429s from tracing-backend for host traces.redwood-int:4317, also OTLP conn resets.
samira: we rolled sampling config canary at 02:14 — switched from 0.05 fixed rate to adaptive rate-based. rolling back now? :thinking:
kevin: attaching small log snippet
kevin: ```
2026-03-05T02:16:57Z agent otlp_exporter warn: send failed: 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-05T02:16:57Z agent queue: length=712/1024, dropped_spans=0
2026-03-05T02:17:02Z agent sampler: decision=root=sampled children=not-sampled
2026-03-05T02:17:03Z agent otlp_exporter error: conn reset by peer
```
alex: interesting: sampler logs show 'children=not-sampled' — is the sampler making per-span decisions without propagating trace flags?
maria: I see traces where traceparent is present on root but flags=0 on child spans from ingress->service. could be header rewrite between services.
ingress-bot: notice: frontend LB recently enabled 'trim-long-headers' to protect downstream, truncates headers > 4096 bytes.
ben: that would nuke tracestate if huge cookies present, downstream OTel SDK may treat as no traceparent and start new root or mark as not-sampled.
samira: but we also saw exporter 429s — so two contributing factors: header trimming + exporter backpressure.
kevin: reproducer: curl with long cookie -> header >4k -> downstream shows no traceparent, child spans start new traces.
maria: action items: 1) rollback sampler rollout in canary (samira) 2) revert LB trim or whitelist trace headers (ingress) 3) increase agent queue and add alert for exporter 429s (ben) 4) open bug for agent behavior dropping children under backpressure (alex)
ben: raising alert now: otlp_exporter_429 rate > 5/min in prod :rotating_light: 
alex: created GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/agent/issues/4321 — adding logs and traces :thumbsup: 
samira: rolling back sampling now.
ingress-bot: revert request submitted to infra: #1234
maria: thanks folks, will follow up with consolidated postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
